classification.summary: RareStakingV1.updateMerkleRoot() attempted to restrict callers with require(msg.sender != owner() || msg.sender != 0xc2F394a45e994bc81EfF678bDE9172e10f7c8ddc). Because the owner and fixed address were distinct, at least one inequality was true for every possible caller, making Merkle-root replacement permissionless. The attacker deployed a helper, set the root to keccak256(abi.encodePacked(helper, the staking proxy's full RARE balance)), and called claim() with that amount and an empty proof in the same transaction, draining the proxy.

loss.notes: The RARE balance of staking proxy 0x3f4d749675b3e48bccd932033808a7079328eb48 is exactly 11907874.713019104529057960 RARE immediately before the anchor and zero afterward. The claim calldata, TokensClaimed event, and RARE Transfer log all independently record that full amount. This is gross asset loss from the staking proxy; later movement and sale of the same tokens are attacker realization and are not added again. DefiLlama's nearest historical RARE observation is 0.061452 USD at timestamp 1753689540, 1379 seconds before the exploit, valuing the loss at 731762.71686445 USD. The legacy 730000 USD amount is a rounded estimate.

lastCodeChange.description: Proxy creation transaction 0x146c6690...a2613 emitted Upgraded(address) at log 457 selecting RareStakingV1 0xffb512b9176d527c5d32189c3e310ed4ab2bb9ec, which had been deployed one transaction earlier. It is the only Upgraded event from proxy creation through the pre-incident block. The EIP-1967 implementation slot continuously identifies that artifact, whose runtime code hash is unchanged from implementation deployment through block 23016422.

sources.note: Reviewed the full exploit call trace and receipt, RARE balances and staking state immediately around the anchor, all NewClaimRootAdded logs, the verified RareStakingV1 source, implementation and proxy creation traces, the full pre-incident Upgraded-event history, the EIP-1967 implementation slot, and historical runtime bytecode. Transaction 0xd813751b...e3c1 creates helper 0x08947cedf35f9669012bda6fda9d03c399b017ab, which calls updateMerkleRoot with keccak256(abi.encodePacked(helper, 11907874713019104529057960)) and immediately claims that amount with an empty proof. The receipt records the new round-3 root, an exact 11907874.713019104529057960 RARE transfer from the proxy, and TokensClaimed for the same amount; the proxy balance goes from that amount at block 23016422 to zero. The implementation was created in transaction 0xdb0dea1a...4802 at block 22739592 index 88. The proxy was created one transaction later by the same deployer and its Upgraded log 457 selected this implementation; no later Upgraded event exists before the incident. The implementation runtime hash is 0x930ba683fe4663a6d05e3a77a00ee531dc1340f6cdb43c08f22d3fd0d2722071 at deployment and pre-incident.
